card.text: F7 star 189 parsecs away whose giant planet WASP-76b has iron condensing on its night side.

introduction.text: WASP-76 is a metal-rich F star about 1.5 times the mass of the Sun. A fainter K-type companion lies 0.44 arcseconds away.

sources.label: Ehrenreich et al. 2020
sources.quote: WASP-76 has a candidate companion separated by 0.4438±0.0053 arcsec

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of Gaia's spectrum of the star. No surface picture exists.
